sources.entry: AppStoreReviewTimes - Gives you indication about the average iOS / macOS app stores review times.

summary.one_liner: An iOS app companion to the appreviewtimes.com site that shows the average App Store review times for iOS and macOS apps.
summary.what_it_does: According to the README, this is an iOS app for the appreviewtimes.com site. It gives an indication of the average review times for iOS and macOS app submissions to the app stores. The README is very brief and contains only a one-line description and an empty Screenshots heading, so it does not describe install steps, features in detail, or the underlying data source beyond the named site.
use_cases: check how long App Store review takes
estimate iOS app submission wait time
notable: Companion app for the appreviewtimes.com site
Covers both iOS and macOS App Store review times
caveats: README is minimal; no setup or build instructions given
Depends on the appreviewtimes.com site for its data
